title: Agentic QA curriculum
goal: Learn to replace low-leverage implementation review with trustworthy behavioral oracles, deterministic gates, and observable proof.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.objective: Own intent and make every completion claim falsifiable before increasing agent autonomy.

skills.name: Behavioral specification and oracle design
skills.why: The entire gauntlet inherits the quality of its behavioral oracle.
skills.competency: Turn intent into positive, negative, boundary, and failure scenarios without prescribing implementation.
skills.firstExercise: Write the acceptance contract and independent oracle for the first kernel gauntlet protocol.

skills.name: Gherkin and structured requirements
skills.why: Executable natural-language specifications become the reviewed source of truth.
skills.competency: Write reusable scenarios whose outcomes can be executed without interpreting prose.
skills.firstExercise: Convert one existing kernel DONE LOOKS LIKE section into executable scenarios.

skills.name: CI gate engineering
skills.why: A constraint only matters when it fails closed and cannot be weakened by the executor.
skills.competency: Turn checks into reproducible non-zero exits, protected required checks, and retained evidence.
skills.firstExercise: Create a machine-readable gate manifest for one real project.

skills.name: Test architecture
skills.why: Unit, contract, integration, and end-to-end tests answer different questions.
skills.competency: Choose the smallest test layer that proves behavior while retaining a real end-to-end witness.
skills.firstExercise: Map one feature's acceptance criteria to the correct test layers.

phases.title: Assurance
phases.objective: Measure whether tests detect faults and whether the real system satisfies the contract.

skills.name: Property-based testing
skills.why: Properties explore broad input spaces and expose boundaries example tests miss.
skills.competency: Express domain invariants, generate inputs, and interpret shrunk counterexamples.
skills.firstExercise: Add a round-trip or state invariant to a suitable project module.

skills.name: Mutation testing
skills.why: Coverage proves execution; mutation score tests whether assertions detect plausible faults.
skills.competency: Run diff-scoped campaigns, triage survivors, and distinguish equivalent mutants from real gaps.
skills.firstExercise: Baseline one project's changed-code mutation score without enforcing a threshold.

skills.name: Static and security gate design
skills.why: Deterministic rules catch recurring AI failure patterns cheaply and reproducibly.
skills.competency: Tune reliability, security, dependency, and secret checks without normalizing false positives.
skills.firstExercise: Define the zero-new-issues policy for agent-authored diffs.

skills.name: Browser and API automation
skills.why: Agents often pass unit tests while the user-visible path remains broken.
skills.competency: Exercise the real interface and verify durable backend state, screenshots, or video.
skills.firstExercise: Capture before-and-after evidence for one production-shaped workflow.

phases.title: Autonomy
phases.objective: Calibrate the harness, contain unknown failures, and formalize only where the risk justifies it.

skills.name: Agent evaluation engineering
skills.why: The harness itself needs regression tests and measured reliability.
skills.competency: Build isolated tasks, reference solutions, deterministic graders, repeated trials, and calibrated rubrics.
skills.firstExercise: Create the first five tasks in a kernel harness regression suite.

skills.name: Observability as a test oracle
skills.why: Logs, metrics, and traces can prove runtime constraints that source inspection cannot.
skills.competency: Express latency, error, and state expectations as queries against isolated or canary telemetry.
skills.firstExercise: Turn one service health claim into a machine-verifiable telemetry assertion.

skills.name: Architecture fitness functions
skills.why: Mechanical boundaries prevent agent throughput from becoming architectural drift.
skills.competency: Encode dependency direction, boundary parsing, file-size, and design invariants as structural checks.
skills.firstExercise: Choose one kernel golden principle and make its violation mechanically detectable.

skills.name: Risk-based QA and sampling
skills.why: Human attention should follow impact and reversibility rather than review every implementation equally.
skills.competency: Assign risk tiers, audit random samples, and track false acceptance and false rejection rates.
skills.firstExercise: Classify three recent tasks using the proposed Tier 0–3 matrix.

skills.name: Formal methods literacy
skills.why: Machine-checked proofs are the strongest gate for narrow, formalizable high-risk logic.
skills.competency: Recognize formalizable problems and model a small state machine or invariant without confusing proof with product intent.
skills.firstExercise: Model one small state transition only after the deterministic gauntlet is operational.
